If `Ann, X, Gus`, then Ann before Gus, but Gus is before Finn, so Ann before Finn. But Dev is before Ann, so Dev before Ann before Gus before Finn. That would put Dev before Gus, but Dev and Gus must be at least 3 apart — possible, but let's test.
